Raids

The following Mega-Evolved Pokémon will appear in raids during the Mega Ascension event.

Mega Raids will make up the majority of raids during the Mega Ascension event. Seasonal Raid Bosses may also appear during this time.

Monday, August 31

  • Mega Victreebel
  • Mega Dragonite
  • Mega Malamar

Tuesday, September 1

  • Mega Falinks

Wednesday, September 2

  • Mega Skarmory

Thursday, September 3

  • Mega Starmie

Friday, September 4

  • Mega Raichu X
  • Mega Raichu Y

Throughout Mega Ascension

Mega Latias and Mega Latios may also appear in Mega Raids throughout the Mega Ascension event.

  • Mega Latias
  • Mega Latios

Pokémon caught from Mega Raids during the Mega Ascension event may have a Mega Evolution–themed Special Background.
